verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose, which lets you decide where the app and its MongoDB data live. Its warehouse-native design means experiment data stays in your own warehouse rather than being sent to GrowthBook. Targeting attribute values stay in SDK memory and are never sent to GrowthBook, and a community user confirms keeping click-stream data in-house rather than sending it to third parties. missing for 10: documented region selection (e.g. EU/US) for GrowthBook Cloud, an explicit data-residency or compliance statement, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
